Definition: a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth.
BiblicalUsage: Meronothite = "joyful shouter"; 1) a native of a place probably called 'Meronoth'; 1a) Jehdeiah; 1b) Jadon
